title: Minimum Operations to Sort a Permutation
summary: Given a permutation of 0 through n-1, sort it increasingly using only a whole-array reversal or a one-position left rotation. Each costs one operation. Return the minimum operations, or -1 if these operations cannot produce sorted order.
officialConstraints: Length 1..100000; each value from 0..n-1 occurs once.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
